definitions.explanation: A general term for sugars as a category, including monosaccharides, disaccharides, and oligosaccharides. Commonly seen on food labels and in nutritional contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{糖類|とうるい}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧だ。
{糖類|とうるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{摂|と}り→摂る：29372_toru⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Consuming too much sugar is not good for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧{成分表|せいぶんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内訳|うちわけ}→内訳：10559_uchiwake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{糖質|とうしつ}→糖質：11091_toushitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{糖類|とうるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at the nutrition label, sugar content and sugars are listed separately under the carbohydrate breakdown.

notes:
Composed of {糖|とう} (sugar) and ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (type, class). Refers to sugars as a chemical or nutritional category, not to table sugar in everyday cooking.

USAGE:
Most commonly encountered on Japanese food labels and in health-related contexts. Japanese nutrition labels distinguish between ⟦{糖質|とうしつ}→糖質：11091_toushitsu⟧ (total digestible carbohydrates minus fiber) and {糖類|とうるい} (simple sugars like glucose and sucrose). Products marketed as '{糖類|とうるい}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧' (zero sugars) may still contain sugar alcohols or artificial sweeteners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糖類|とうるい}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero sugars; sugar-free
- {糖類|とうるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧: sugar intake
- {糖類|とうるい}⟦{不使用|ふしよう}→不使用：29835_fushiyou⟧: no added sugars
- {糖類|とうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧: to cut back on sugars

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧: sugar — specifically table sugar (sucrose); {糖類|とうるい} is the broader scientific/nutritional category
- ⟦{糖質|とうしつ}→糖質：11091_toushitsu⟧: carbohydrates (digestible) — a broader category that includes {糖類|とうるい} plus starches and sugar alcohols
- ⟦{糖分|とうぶん}→糖分：15847_toubun⟧: sugar content — the amount of sugar in a food, used more casually than {糖類|とうるい}
